_comment: schema-reference-lint escapes (SD-LEO-INFRA-SCHEMA-REFERENCE-LINT-001). files: repo-relative paths whose DB client targets ANOTHER database (e.g. the EHG app project) or whose table names are dynamic/templated. tables: relation names to skip everywhere (e.g. tables that exist only in the EHG app DB but are referenced from cross-DB scripts). Prefer the inline pragma (schema-lint-disable-line) for single intentional lines.
_venture_scope_note: SD-LEO-INFRA-ADAM-DURABLE-STANDING-001: this file has no static table references at all. validateVentureOwnership() calls .from(resourceTable) where resourceTable is a RUNTIME PARAMETER — the dynamic case this list exists for — and the only literal, supabase.from('table') at :162, is a placeholder inside a JSDoc usage example. The violation is pre-existing on origin/main (the file is byte-identical there); it surfaces only in a PR whose merge widens the diff-vs-base range to include this untouched file, so it blocks unrelated PRs at random. The inline pragma was rejected as the fix because this file's stored blob is CRLF while .gitattributes demands LF, so touching a single line renormalizes all 231 lines.
_operator_contract_test_note: SD-LEO-INFRA-OPERATOR-CONTRACT-GATE-001: these unit tests use deliberately-fictional fixture table names (foo_events, venture_signals) to exercise detectCreator/consumer/reaper against synthetic CREATOR diffs — they are not real relations.
_operator_contract_test_note_3: SD-LEO-INFRA-OPERATOR-CONTRACT-GATE-002 adds two more suites in the same directory for the same structural reason, and the second is worth naming: harness-adapter-hostile-config.test.js BUILDS ADVERSARIAL FIXTURE REPOS whose whole purpose is to contain table-name-shaped text that is deliberately not a relation (receipts, new_thing, widgets). A security fixture for a detector of DB references necessarily looks like a DB reference, and it must, or the vector it arms would not be live. Third time this lint has read this SD lineage fixtures as live schema — see note_2; the pattern is inherent to testing a tool that reasons about supabase.from() strings, not a recurring authoring mistake.
_operator_contract_test_note_2: SD-LEO-INFRA-VERIFY-CONSUMER-HANDOFF-001 extends the same escape to seven more suites in that directory, for the identical reason: this gate's whole job is to reason about supabase.from(...).insert/select STRINGS, so its fixtures must contain table-name-shaped text that is deliberately NOT a relation — 't', 'trend_eyes_receipts', 'reap_receipts', 'venture_events'. A fixture for a detector of DB references necessarily looks like a DB reference. Two flagged hits were NOT fixtures but COMMENTS (harness-adapter.js:30, index.js:199) and take the inline schema-lint-disable-line pragma instead, since allowlisting whole production files would blind the lint to real references beside the prose. Worth recording: this is the third tool in one day to read this SD's fixtures or comments as live code — detectCreator did it twice (a fixture, then the comment explaining the fixture) and both were real bugs that blocked this SD's own handoff. A linter that scans prose is a recurring shape here, not a one-off.
_drive_report_tables_note: SD-LEO-INFRA-DRIVE-LOOP-INSTRUMENT-001-C: both relations are created by SIBLING SD -B's migration, which has not landed (PR #6784). Measured live at authoring: PGRST205 for both, with strategic_directives_v2 as a positive control and a fabricated name as a negative control. The consumer scripts/coordinator-drive-report-consume.mjs is FAIL-SOFT on absence BY CONSTRUCTION and this entry is what forced that: isRelationAbsent() routes ONLY PGRST205/42P01 to a distinct status='pending_migration' on BOTH the read and the write path, while permission denied, JWT expiry, constraint violations and timeouts all still return status='failed' (asserted in both directions by tests/unit/drive-loop/drive-report-consume.test.js and by mutants M14/M15). The first version of this SD reported status='failed' on every 15-minute tick for a condition that was the normal state of the world -- an alarm guaranteed to be firing on the day it was installed. pending_migration is deliberately NOT folded into 'ok' or 'nothing_to_consume': runCoresFailSoft records key:status and drops detail, so status is the only field a human sees, and a consumer that never runs must not read as a consumer with nothing to do. Remove from this allowlist and re-run npm run schema:snapshot:lint after -B's migration applies.

_sms_approved_spend_ledger_note: chairman-gated, staged-not-applied table (SD-LEO-FEAT-SMS-CHAIRMAN-DECISION-001-B, FR-2): migration database/migrations/20260717_sms_spend_envelope_STAGED.sql is the STAGED chairman-gated spend ledger (RLS-at-create: ENABLE RLS + service-role FOR ALL write policy + chairman-only SELECT, all in the same file) plus the atomic SECURITY DEFINER debit_sms_daily_spend RPC and the new chairman_decisions gating columns (amount_usd/undo_deadline/undone_at/consumed_at). Deliberately not applied pre-ceremony. The ledger is written ONLY via the RPC (no .from() in code), and the referencing seam lib/chairman/sms-bridge.js (consumeSmsReply) + lib/chairman/sms-spend-caps.js (debitSmsDailySpend) are FAIL-CLOSED by construction: a missing table/RPC/column resolves to {error}/{data:null} and the seam returns non-actionable (routes to console), never approving a spend. The staged chairman_decisions columns carry inline schema-lint-disable-line pragmas. Remove from this allowlist (and drop the pragmas) and re-run npm run schema:snapshot:lint after a chairman applies the migration.
_sms_outbound_obligations_note: CORRECTED SD-LEO-FIX-SMS-OUTBOUND-WORKER-002 (escalated from QF-20260728-870, FR-4): the table itself is LIVE — applied via database/migrations/20260718_sms_outbound_obligations_APPROVED.sql (sha256-matched in schema_migrations_applied, applied_at 2026-07-19T13:39:00Z), NOT the sibling _STAGED.sql file, which was edited post-hoc to describe an owed_escalate status value and a prior_provider_message_ids column that were never actually applied — that drift is the bug this SD fixes (a since-corrected superseded notice is in the _STAGED.sql file itself). This entry stays in tables[] ONLY because of those two still-unapplied attributes: lib/chairman/sms-outbound-worker.js escalate() writes status='owed_escalate' (rejected by the live CHECK constraint until applied) and reads/writes prior_provider_message_ids (a column that does not exist live yet). The dedicated chairman-gated fix is database/chairman-gated/20260822_sms_outbound_obligations_owed_escalate_column_drift.sql (DROP+ADD CONSTRAINT to admit owed_escalate, ADD COLUMN prior_provider_message_ids) — apply THAT file, not the STAGED.sql CREATE TABLE body, which is now a no-op against the live table (IF NOT EXISTS). Both write-result-checking call sites are FAIL-SOFT/loud-warn by construction (SD-LEO-FIX-SMS-OUTBOUND-WORKER-002 FR-1): a rejected write logs a warning and the row remains in its pre-write status for the next sweep, never silently dropped. Remove from this allowlist and re-run npm run schema:snapshot:lint after a chairman applies the 20260822 column-drift migration.

The referencing function lib/switch-automation/prechecks/audit-stamp.js computePolicyVersion() is FAIL-SOFT by construction: a query error is caught and returns the sentinel string 'policy-table-not-live' (verified by its own unit test), never throws. _drive_reports_note: chairman-gated, staged-not-applied table (SD-LEO-INFRA-DRIVE-LOOP-INSTRUMENT-001-B FR-4): database/migrations/20260803_drive_reports.sql creates drive_reports + drive_report_receipts with RLS, a single service_role policy and a DO $verify$ block, and is deliberately NOT applied pre-chairman — only scripts/apply-migration.js --prod-deploy applies it. The tables entry was already on main; this note supplies the reason and the removal condition, because an allowlist entry that outlives its reason is a permanent hole wearing a temporary exemption. FAIL-BEHAVIOUR, STATED HONESTLY RATHER THAN CLAIMED FAIL-SOFT: the SMS leg IS fail-soft — drive-report-sms-sweep.mjs findLatestReport() discards the error and returns null, which the sweep reports as the MISSING signal, and that is the designed TR-3 behaviour (no fresh report IS the alarm). The CRON PRODUCER PATH is scripts/cron/drive-report-sweep.mjs (NOT drive-report-produce.mjs — an earlier version of this note named the wrong script). It does NOT fail on every in-window tick: since 11caae622cb a missing table (PGRST205/42P01) returns { id: null, blocked: 'table_absent' } and the sweep exits cleanly WITHOUT stamping the registry, deliberately, so the run is not recorded as a success. Every OTHER error still throws. ONE HONEST CAVEAT, and it is AC-8/FR-7 shipping unmet: not stamping leaves periodic_process_registry.last_fired_at NULL, and periodic-liveness-watcher.mjs:247-248 reads NULL as UNVERIFIED rather than OVERDUE — escalating only past 7 continuous days, not at the 2x cadence FR-7 promises. So between merge and the chairman apply the absence is visible but does not alarm on FR-7's schedule. REMOVE THIS ENTRY and re-run npm run schema:snapshot:lint once a chairman applies the migration.
_venture_gate_attestations_note: chairman-gated, staged-not-applied table + view (SD-FDBK-FIX-VENTURE-CRACK-GATE-001): database/chairman-gated/20260817_venture_gate_attestations.sql creates venture_gate_attestations + v_venture_gate_attestations_latest with RLS, append-only triggers (incl. a statement-level TRUNCATE guard) and a DO $verify$ block, and is deliberately NOT applied pre-chairman. FAIL-SOFT by construction: lib/eva/lifecycle/crack-gate-evaluator.js's fetchLatestAttestation() catches a missing-relation error (PGRST205/42P01/schema-cache-miss) and returns a distinct verdict='ATTESTATION_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE' rather than throwing, so both consumers (the observe-only detective sweep and the observe-only publish-gate precondition) degrade gracefully with no live path crashing. Remove from this allowlist and re-run npm run schema:snapshot:lint after a chairman applies the migration.
_agent_readiness_tables_note: chairman-gated, staged-not-applied tables + view (SD-LEO-FEAT-AGENT-READINESS-SERVICE-001, coordinator ruling on signal 6555f927): database/chairman-gated/20260816_agent_readiness_audit_schema.sql is deliberately NOT applied — no live apply from any seat, rides the next chairman ceremony. FAIL-BEHAVIOUR STATED HONESTLY, NOT FAIL-SOFT: unlike every other entry in this section, lib/agent-readiness/run-registry.js, sample-writer.js, diff-harness.js and llm-txt-version-store.js all THROW LOUDLY on any Supabase error including a missing-table PGRST205/42P01 (verified by direct source read, not assumed) — this is INTENTIONAL, not a gap to paper over: measured via grep across the whole repo (excluding lib/agent-readiness/ and tests/agent-readiness/ themselves), these four modules have NO live caller anywhere — no cron, no webhook, no API endpoint invokes runAudit()/registerAuditRun()/writeSample()/computeDiff()/draftVersion() today. They are only ever invoked by an explicit dogfood/ceremony run, which by construction only happens after the migration is applied, so there is no live-running path this absence could crash. The fail-soft precedent other entries need (protecting an already-running cron/webhook from a table that hasn't landed yet) does not apply here because nothing is running yet. Remove this entry and re-run npm run schema:snapshot:lint after a chairman applies the migration — at that point also re-verify no caller was wired in during the interim without matching fail-behavior.
_worker_wind_down_events_note: chairman-gated, staged-not-applied table (SD-LEO-INFRA-WIND-DOWN-SURVEY-001 FR-1): database/migrations/20260821_worker_wind_down_events.sql carries the @chairman-gated header (REVOKE/GRANT statements required for the RLS-only service-role posture are in migration-tier-classifier.mjs's FORBIDDEN_TOPLEVEL set, forcing TIER-2) and is deliberately NOT applied pre-chairman. The ONLY referencing call site is scripts/hooks/stop-loop-wakeup-reminder.cjs recordWindDown()'s (c) block, which fires on EVERY worker Stop-hook fleet-wide and is FAIL-OPEN BY CONSTRUCTION: both the insert and its error handling live inside a try/catch that never re-throws (verified by REGRESSION evidence b24d51fc — signature/behavior byte-identical to main aside from the (c) block's rewrite, still never throws), so a missing-table error (42P01/PGRST205) during the gating window logs one stderr line per stop and returns normally — no live worker-loop path can be blocked or crashed by this table's absence. Remove this entry and re-run npm run schema:snapshot:lint after a chairman applies the migration.
